🎮 Welcome to Ben’s Minecraft Server!

Looking for a fresh, lag-free Survival experience? Whether you’re on PC, Mobile, or Console, hop on and start building your dream base with our friendly community!

📍 Server Details

• IP: mc.benwyw.com

• Version: Java Survival (Java & Bedrock Cross-Play Supported)

• Location: Singapore (24/7 High-Speed Hosting) 🇸🇬

✨ Key Features

• 🛡️ Land Claim Protection: Protect your builds, chests, and terrain with ease.

• 🎲 Random Teleport (RTP): One command to warp instantly into the wild and start exploring.

• 🗺️ Live Web Map: Keep track of your builds and the world in real-time.

• 🤝 Cross-Platform: Play seamlessly with friends on Java & Bedrock!
